01 AI-first curriculum

Build products with AI, not around it

AI runs through every stage of the product craft — how you discover problems, size opportunities, spec solutions and ship. You learn modern PM in the same tools the best teams already use, from discovery through to launch.

Discovery
Product strategy
AI prototyping

Program curriculum

14 modules · 3 phases · 2 electives · 13 portfolio projects

Phase 1: Craft

Product thinking, research instincts and problem-solving fundamentals

[ 4 Modules ]

Phase 2

Phase 3

Electives

Phase 4

Module 01

Fundamentals of product management

What PMs actually do, product sense through teardowns, B2B vs B2C roles and your first real user conversation

Module 02

Product strategy & strategic thinking

Vision, positioning, competitive moats, bet sizing, the new builder operating model and your own one-page product strategy

Module 03

Problem discovery, market & user research

Personas, qualitative and quantitative research, and mapping B2B buying committees

Module 04

Problem framing & prioritization

Problem statements, user stories, RICE, MoSCoW, first-principles thinking and back-of-envelope market sizing

Phase 1

Phase 2: Craft + AI

Core PM work with AI as a working partner

[ 4 Modules ]

Phase 3

Electives

Phase 4

Module 05

UX & design collaboration

Design critique, wireframes and a clickable Figma prototype built with ChatGPT and Claude, tested with a real user

Module 06

Effective communication as a PM

Pick your product case and write its PRD, plus stakeholder management, B2B communication and quality criteria for AI features

Module 07

Analytics & metrics

North Star metrics, real SQL on a sample data warehouse, funnels and cohorts in Amplitude, and A/B test analysis

Module 08

Product launch & monetization

STP, MVPs and launch planning, monetization models, pricing AI products and B2B go-to-market

Phase 1

Phase 2

Phase 3: Deep AI

Build, evaluate and ship AI-powered products

[ 6 Modules ]

Electives

Phase 4

Module 09

Tech 101 for PMs

How an app fits together, a real API call in Postman, Git, and running sprints with engineering

Module 10

LLMs, RAG & AI foundations

LLM fundamentals, prompting, the fine-tuning vs RAG vs prompting decision, and eval design

Module 11

Vibe coding for PMs

Run your PRD as a sprint with Claude Code, raise a pull request in a real codebase and set up OpenCode, a free coding agent you keep

Module 12

Agents in production

When to use an agent, MCP, context engineering and guardrails, and your own personal agent with memory and skills

Phase 1

Phase 2

Phase 3

Electives

Two optional electives of 4 sessions each, run alongside your capstone. Take one or both

[ 2 Electives ]

Phase 4

Elective A

System design for PMs

Caches, queues and a UPI payments flow, then AI feature and agent architecture, ending in an architecture doc for your capstone

Elective B

Growth and business for PMs

Growth loops, retention, experiments and unit economics, with Canva, Meesho and CRED teardowns and a growth plan for your capstone

Phase 1

Phase 2

Phase 3

Electives

Phase 4: Interview prep

Weekly expert-led sessions across 8 interview rounds, once the first 3 phases are done

[ 8 Round types ]

Round 01

AI interview

Show your AI-first skills and perform in AI-driven interview rounds

Round 02

Execution

Handle ambiguity, and diagnose what went wrong and why

Round 03

Product design

Find creative solutions to difficult or unusual problems

Round 04

Product improvement

Improve existing products to meet customer needs and add value

Muthuraj Thangavel

Senior Product Manager @

I lead Google Cloud's identity security portfolio, which protects millions of users and AI agents, along with a customer identity platform used by billions of people every month.

I launched Google's identity threat detection offering, cutting security response time from days to seconds, and I'll show you how to take a complex product from idea to launch.

15+ years of experience

Karan Sethi

Product Leader, B2B gift card distribution @

I lead Pine Labs' B2B gift card distribution platform, owning the product from strategy through go-to-market and revenue.

Just before this I led growth at Optiva, launching a new B2B2X product line with GenAI built in, and I'll teach you to turn AI from an experiment into revenue.

15+ years of experience

Sumant Malhotra

Head of Product and Growth @

I run product and growth as fractional CPO at Product Career Academy, and I coach PMs who want to move into AI product roles.

I've coached 1200+ PMs through the AI PM interview, from RAG and evals to model trade-offs, and I'll help you tell your story the way hiring managers want to hear it.

10+ years of experience

Co-founder @
